_doc: 像素小人模板（A4 固化，2026-08-14）。参考方舟/FGO 2D 小人；像素复用 char_ailin_v2 最优版本

pixel.style_signature: 16-bit pixel art sprite, limited color palette, hard edges, grid-aligned pixels, no anti-aliasing, sprite-sheet ready, readable silhouette at small size

views.front: front view, idle, standing facing viewer, full body
views.side: side view, full body, profile facing left, same character design as front view
views.back: back view, full body, seen from behind, same character design
views.three_view: character sheet, front / side / back three views, same character, consistent design
views.idle: animation frame, idle pose, single frame, consistent with reference
views.walk: animation frame, walk cycle pose, single frame, consistent with reference
views.attack: animation frame, attacking pose, single frame, consistent with reference
views.hurt: animation frame, hurt pose, single frame, consistent with reference
views.sprite_sheet: sprite sheet, evenly spaced grid of animation frames, same character

pixel.output_constraint: same character, consistent design, no text, no watermark
